note: DESCO's schedule PDFs contain typos and overlapping-text extraction artifacts in the S&D Division column. This table is the ONLY place a variant may be folded into a canonical name, so every mapping is reviewable in one diff. The verbatim source string is always kept in the claim's `division` field; the canonical name goes in `division_canonical`. Variants mapped to null are unusable garble - claims carrying them are published with a null canonical division and are excluded from geographic matching rather than being guessed at.
